diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-3 followed by read-only DOM geometry observations

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 菜单快照列出两个同 URL 链接，但官方 Moli 1.1.6 中第二个菜单链接虽计算为可见，其布局矩形仍为零，因而原轨迹的第二个 :visible 实例无法匹配。固定候选在同一动作前缀下给出非零矩形并完成后续动作。该行为与动态 DOM 更新后复用旧布局快照的已证实故障家族相符。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The menu snapshot lists two links with the same URL, but the second submenu link has a zero-area rectangle on official Moli 1.1.6 despite visible computed style. The original trajectory's second :visible instance therefore cannot match. The fixed candidate gives it nonzero geometry after the same action prefix and completes the remaining actions. This is consistent with the established stale-snapshot-after-dynamic-update defect family.
reviewed_cause.source_location: moli-renderer-v8/src/native_bridge/context_host/layout.rs; Moli commit adde6e4f guards geometry queries against dirty frozen layout trees

scope_limit: This is a read-only same-page geometry comparison using official 1.1.6 and the fixed candidate, not a rerun of the formal 1.1.3 binary or a commit-level bisect. It does not establish the cause of every selector timeout or independently certify the candidate's complete task semantics.
